questions.prompt: A change makes the loop stop after the tool result. The fixture has 2 recorded replies. What does replay report?
options: That 1 recorded call was never used
questions.explanation: The loop used only reply 1, so assertConsumed finds 1 unused recorded call and fails the test.

questions.prompt: Why can a session file serve as a recording of the model?
options: Each assistant/message event stores the blocks the model wrote, in order
The file stores the HTTP bytes
The model saves its own replies in the file
The file has the system prompt only
questions.explanation: The record keeps every assistant message with its blocks, so turning those blocks back into chunks gives each reply in order.

questions.prompt: When does a replay test need an API key?
options: Only once, when the fixture is recorded
questions.explanation: The live run that makes the fixture calls the real model once. Every later run reads the file and needs no key.
